conditions: One individual: holotype WZULXHTXSP1, adult female, as printed 'An adult female (WZULXHTXSP1) collected on 7 May 2024 by Jun-Jie Zhong from Liuxihe National Forest Park (23.73°N, 113.84°E; altitude 460 m above sea level), Guangzhou City, Greater Bay Area, Guangdong Province, China.' Paratypes as printed: 'A series of juvenile paratypes (WZULXHTXSP2–5) collected on 20 July 2024 by Jun-Jie Zhong and Kun Guo from the type locality.'; the Description of holotype is the only place the nostril is described, so no paratype value exists. The Methods print no fixation or preservation sentence for the types; the only handling sentence reads (pieces joined) 'All living specimens were transported to our laboratory at Wenzhou University and subsequently deposited as voucher specimens in the Research Center of Herpetology.' and Colour variation says 'In preservative, the dorsal ground color of the body becomes bluish gray' (so the description was written from a preserved specimen but the medium is not stated).
